summary.headline: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 129% YoY to INR 158.3 crore, driven by first full quarter of Netcom BCC, with EBITDA margin at 24.9%.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 was the first full reporting period consolidating Netcom BCC, lifting consolidated revenue to INR 158.3 crore (up 64.6% QoQ, 129% YoY) and EBITDA to INR 39.4 crore (24.9% margin). Profit for the period rose to INR 16.3 crore, with basic EPS of 0.62 versus 0.36 a year ago. Finance cost rose to INR 8.1 crore from INR 1.9 crore, tied to acquisition borrowing. Management positioned the company as moving from capacity-led outsourcing toward outcome-based AI orchestration through its ResolX platform, while the standalone base business grew 11.6% YoY.

financial_highlights.change: vs INR 1.9 crore a year ago

financial_highlights.value: ~50% of revenue and ~50% of EBITDA; Netcom margin ~24-25%

segments.name: Global human service engine (incl. Netcom BCC)
segments.commentary: Netcom fully consolidated this quarter, deepening Americas presence; contributes roughly half of consolidated revenue and EBITDA at ~24-25% margin.

segments.name: Base business (standalone)
segments.commentary: Standalone revenue INR 61.1 crore, up 11.6% YoY, at 30.4% EBITDA margin.

segments.name: Agentic AI engine (ResolX)
segments.commentary: Launched May 2026; 12 live deployments across seven enterprise clients. Revenue described as only just starting to catch up; management expects meaningful revenue in 12-18 months or slightly more.

guidance_outlook: Management said the company should be able to roughly double revenue this year, while acknowledging this was not a one-off quarter.
Management expects EBITDA margins to improve progressively over the coming year as the revenue mix shifts to AI orchestration and outcome-linked models.
Cash generation expected to rise in coming quarters, making debt servicing easier; no equity raise indicated.
Management intends to acquire two more companies over the next three years, targeting firms with Fortune 500 clients in North America.
AI-led revenue expected to show up in quarterly numbers over the coming 12-18 months.
capex_capacity: Netcom BCC acquisition debt carries an effective cost of around 9%; management said total debt is about INR 220 crore and a repayment schedule is planned.

ResolX platform: 12 live deployments across seven enterprise clients (insurance, aviation, banking, automotive, digital assets), including two Central American banks; management said about 6-7 of 12 projects were deployed as of the call.
Management plans roughly 40-plus bots for one Indian insurance client across languages and its 7-8 products.
Management said capacity is not a constraint, with AI expected to free room in accounts for additional work.
demand_pricing: Management expects growth from India and LATAM, with the Americas growing on dollar arbitrage; banking is the leading vertical, with some insurance, healthcare, travel and hospitality.
AI deflection to humans reported at roughly 30-40% depending on use case; one airline deployment cited about 30% of employee-size benefit.
Management claims the company is the only Indian BPO with in-house domain, tech stack and Agentic AI capabilities; other BPOs described as relying on third-party AI.
Conversion rate on active deal pipeline stated at around 10-12%.

qa_highlights.question: Is the current quarter's run rate one-off or sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is not one-off, as this is the first quarter with full Netcom consolidation, and it expects revenue to roughly double this year.

qa_highlights.question: Split of revenue and EBITDA between Netcom and base business, and margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Netcom contributes about 50% of revenue and about 50% of EBITDA, with margins of 24-25%, similar to group margin.

qa_highlights.question: Plan for INR 220 crore debt?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said cash earnings will rise, debt servicing will get easier, and repayment is planned; the company is described as debt-free apart from Netcom acquisition borrowing at about 9%.

qa_highlights.question: Does ResolX/Agentic AI generate savings or margin lift yet?
qa_highlights.answer: Margin benefit is visible in a few projects but is too small to be noticeable yet; deflection to humans is about 30-40%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Singapore acquisition and revenue there?
qa_highlights.answer: The Singapore company acquired in 2025 served as the platform later relaunched as ResolX; there is no current revenue in Singapore, with small revenues in the Middle East, Europe, LATAM and India.

qa_highlights.question: What is the blended cost of debt, and acquisition criteria?
qa_highlights.answer: Debt sits mainly with Netcom at about 9%. Acquisition screen is EPS accretion first, then North American customer access; management said margin accretion is immediate.

qa_highlights.question: Pricing and monetisation of resolution-based model?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said resolution cost is measured by time and motion across channels, and that single-owner end-to-end handling shortens interactions (e.g. 5 minutes to 2 minutes).

risks_watch: Margin progression: consolidated EBITDA margin 24.9% is below standalone 30.4%, due to Netcom mix; AI-driven margin uplift is still small.
AI revenue timing: management guided to 12-18 months or longer before AI revenue is meaningful.
Debt of about INR 220 crore at ~9% cost on Netcom acquisition; finance cost rose to INR 8.1 crore.
Management's claim of unique positioning and high 10-12% deal conversion has not been independently verified.
Revenue doubling target for FY27 relies on Netcom consolidation plus new customer ramp-ups.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on the ResolX/Agentic AI narrative and growth trajectory, but vague or evasive on AI-driven margin and revenue quantification, which management repeatedly deferred to future quarters. Some answers on competition and differentiation were assertive without supporting data.
key_quotes: Today, I can say that we are the only ones who exist in India who have the domain plus tech stack plus Agentic AI capabilities, which is truly born within the organization.
We are not in the business of creating LLMs, which is your Large Language Models. What we are in the business is on what sits on top of an LLM.

growth.why: Management says revenue should roughly double in FY27 (about +100%), but the support is qualitative: Netcom consolidation inflates the YoY base, ResolX revenue is only "catching up" with meaningful revenue 12-18 months out, and no capacity additions or order-book figures were given.
